title: Adjunct Faculty Talent Pool - Business
description:
The Faculty Talent Pools are for applicants who want to be
considered for future adjunct faculty positions at NIC. While may
not currently have an immediate opening in this division, joining
the pool will allow the division chair to review your
qualifications before a need arises.

NIC does not allow for remote teaching. To be considered, you
must reside in Idaho, Eastern Washington or be willing to relocate
to the area.

Required Degree: Master's degree in Business, Economics, or
Accounting.

Application Deadline: Review of files happens when a need
arises.

Submission Requirements: Letter of Interest, Resume/CV,
Unofficial Transcripts from your highest or most relevant
degree.

If a full-time position were to become available you would need
to apply separately for that position.
